item.title: Version 3.4.0
item.description: - **Refunded codes:** Rostrum checks for turned-off codes about once a day instead of every two weeks. - **Copy and paste:** ⌘C, ⌘V, ⌘X, ⌘A and ⌘Z work everywhere again, including Notes and the Tutor. - **Copy a whole answer:** Tutor and Assistant answers have a Copy button. - **Headings:** Heading 1–3 keep their sizes when you stop editing a note. - **Style menu:** each style is shown at its own size. - **Stop a quiz or exam:** end it early and only the questions you did are scored. - **Done in Notes:** saves the note and leaves editing. - **Notes archive:** notes from last term's courses fold into an Archive at the bottom of the list. - **Notes filter:** now sits above the list of notes. - **Miscellaneous:** the Tools group in the sidebar is now called Miscellaneous. - **What's new:** the update window shows what changed (it was empty).
